episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the critical importance of consistent client communication and how it can prevent deal loss. He also explores the role of AI in real estate, emphasizing that while AI can enhance efficiency, it won't replace the need for emotional intelligence and personal touch in client interactions. The episode provides actionable insights for agents to improve their follow-up practices and leverage technology effectively.
